findings.title: Adornment as a settled consequence
findings.claim: The focus's final praise of the resting place can carry beauty as the settled result of faithful, sound work: the ordinary good resting place remains, while the wider surah contrasts its durable reward with earthly adornment that tests and passes away.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the focus's HSN verdict at 18:31:27:2; the independent same-surah triggers at 18:7, 18:2, 18:46, 18:104, 18:107, and 18:108 connect adornment, righteous work, reward, lodging, and abiding, so the closing praise reads as consequence rather than display alone.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the closing beauty verdict can be more than visual luxury: the scene is the durable outcome of the work named around it.
findings.containment: The plain praise and the material adornment remain intact; this does not reduce all beauty to moral value or claim that every occurrence of the root carries the resonance.

epistemic.reason: A trusted anchored publication and the exact focus branch are supported by same-surah connection nominations; no unbound source is needed for this finding.
